summary: A single clickable option inside a segmented control, like one button in a set of toggle buttons.
description: A single item within a moz-segmented-control, rendered as a button that can be selected. Implemented as MozSegmentedControlItem, which mixes SelectControlItemMixin into MozButton, in the same file as moz-segmented-control. Note: the Acorn API's coverage table lists this tagName as null/unregistered, but the file does call customElements.define("moz-segmented-control-item", MozSegmentedControlItem), so it is a real registered custom element.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether this item is selected. Internally toggles the underlying moz-button's type between "primary" (checked) and "ghost" (unchecked).

attributes.name: parentDisabled
attributes.description: Set by the parent moz-segmented-control when it is disabled.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: Accessible label when no visible label is present.

events.name: input
events.description: Manually dispatched (bubbles, composed) on click, since the item is not backed by a native input. Not dispatched when the item is disabled or already checked, since handleClick returns before dispatching.

events.name: change
events.description: Manually dispatched (bubbles, composed) on click, alongside input. Not dispatched when the item is disabled or already checked, since handleClick returns before dispatching.
